pages.title: The Identifier Counter
pages.text: Right-click the block or its Identifier to open the counter. Place up to seven unidentified drops in the tray.$(br2)Check the total, then confirm. Identification reveals the prepared batch. Collect the results when the rolling animation ends.

pages.title: Leaving the Counter
pages.text: Unpaid gear is returned if you close the counter. A paid batch is recovered as prepared results if you leave before its reveal finishes.$(br2)The $(bold)Salvage$() button opens the matching anvil. Navigation is blocked during a paid rolling animation; wait for the reveal to finish.
